description: calcSubtotal accumulates monetary amounts as IEEE 754 floating-point dollars (parseFloat * qty) then converts to cents via Math.round. Floating-point addition of decimal values (e.g. 0.1+0.2) introduces rounding errors that compound across line items, silently corrupting invoice totals. Money must use integer cents throughout or a decimal library.

parseFloat on a non-numeric or empty price string returns NaN, which then silently propagates through the entire subtotal accumulation, producing a NaN grand total. There is no input validation or NaN guard before the value is used in arithmetic.
